full_judgment: 2. The relevant facts necessary for the disposal of this civil appeal are that the predecessor of respondents No.1 (a)-1(c) namely, Dr. Ashequr Rahman Khan as petitioner filed Pre-emption Miscellaneous Case No. 17 of 1998 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Sereenagor, Munshigonj under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for pre-emption of .26 acre of land as appended to the petition. The petitioner's case, in a nutshell, is that he is a co-sharer in the case holding by way of settlement from Kazi Shamsul Huda and others. No statutory notice was served upon the pre-emptor before the alleged transfer. He came to know about the alleged transfers dated 23.09.1981 and the decree as to the declaration of title to the case land in favor of the pre-emptee in Title Suit No. 7 of 1990 only on 12.01.1998. Subsequently, by way of an amendment brought on 05.04.1999, it was stated that the pre-emptor came to know about the alleged Kabalas No. 5315, 5317 & 5319 dated 23.09.1981 and the decree from on Bazlar Rahman. Neither the vendor nor the pre-emptee possesses the case land while the pre-emptor and other co-sharers are in possession thereof. 3. The appellants as pre-emptee contested the case by filing written objection and additional written objection denying all the material allegations made in the pre-emption application and contended, inter alia, that the pre-emption application was barred by limitation. The pre-emptor was not a co-sharer in the case holding, One Shova Rani being the rightful owner of the case land transferred the same in favour of the pre-emptee by three registered sale deeds and delivered possession thereof to her. As the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Sreenagor theatened to lease out the case land treating the same as Khas land, the pre-emptee instituted Title Suit No. 7 of 1990 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Sreenagar for declaration of title and permanent injunction in respect of the case land and upon trial the said suit was decreed and as such the pre-emption case is liable to be rejected.
